note: Both sets extract essentially the same cooking water-weight facts with correct values, units and threshold conditions, and both quote the page accurately. Set B repeats the 96.00 oz starting-water minimum one extra time (five near-identical claims versus four in A), adding duplication without adding information. Both sets omit the headline vaporization targets of 5.000 lb (80.00 oz / 2.268 kg) for full points and 1.000 lb (16.00 oz / 0.454 kg) as the reduced-points lower bound stated in Rule 9-2 and 9-2a.
remarks: Both extractions are heavily redundant: the 96.00 oz / 2.721 kg starting-water minimum is restated under slightly different condition labels ('Cooking Subcontest', 'minimum', 'minimum requirement for vaporizing task', 'Contest 9-2 Cooking; vaporized in a single task'), and the 16 oz/450 g and 80 oz/2300 g thresholds are each split into separate unit claims. Some quotes are bare fragments ('(2.721 kg)') that only support the claim in context. Important facts both sets miss: the 5.000 lb (80.00 oz / 2.268 kg) vaporization target for all available points, the 1.000 lb (16.00 oz / 0.454 kg) reduced-points lower bound from Rule 9-2a, and the single-container requirement. The Dinner Party section (9-3) yields no claims in either set.
